description: World - Modern Energy Cooking Services (MECS) Systematic Review is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by ESMAP (World Bank Group). The systematic review of published evidence on drivers of and barriers to transitioning populations to modern energy cooking services (MECS) was conducted under the MECS Program, a five-year initiative funded by UK Aid of the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and led by Loughborough University and the World Bank's Energy Sector Management Assistance Program ... Coverage: 47 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean, South Asia. It has 2 files in DOC, XLS. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
